usage.entry: peer <command>         pair machines and grant exact Agent work scopes
inbox_next: Next inbox page: clawdline cloud peer inbox %s %s %s
started: pair %s is waiting; compare source fingerprint %s on the target machine
accepted: pair %s is active here; ask the source machine to sync it
synced: pair %s is pinned on this machine
granted: grant %s permits %s; source machine must sync it
grant_synced: grant %s is pinned on this machine
revoked: %s %s is revoked locally and in Cloud
sent: request %s was written to the socket; check its relay receipt with cloud peer outbox; target execution remains unknown
outbox_receipt: request %s: relay accepted %s; socket delivery %s; target execution unknown
